entries.title: Canvas Design supplied-snapshot adaptation
uses: Compose static posters, covers, and graphic artwork for PNG or PDF delivery with deliberate typography and spatial hierarchy. Use for a fixed visual composition rather than editable SVG tooling, procedural exploration, or multipage documents.
